summary: Iteration 182 - Signup OTP Email Verification Tests - ALL PASSED. Backend APIs (send-signup-otp, verify-signup-otp, register with emailVerificationToken) working correctly. Frontend registration form shows 'Verify Email with OTP' button after email availability check. Forgot password page shows mode selector with 'Reset via OTP' and 'Reset via Email Link' options.
critical_code_review_comments: Signup OTP uses separate collection 'signup_otp_tokens' - good isolation from forgot password OTP
Registration now REQUIRES emailVerificationToken - returns 400 'Email verification is required' without it
Verification token valid for 15 minutes after OTP verification
Rate limiting: 1 OTP per 60 seconds per email
Max 3 attempts per OTP - after 3 wrong attempts, OTP is marked as used
Email enumeration prevented on send-signup-otp: returns 400 'Email already registered' for existing emails
Frontend RegisterForm.js correctly shows 'Verify Email with OTP' button when email is available
Frontend ForgotPassword.js correctly shows mode selector with OTP and Link options
context_for_next_testing_agent: Signup OTP email verification fully tested. Note: Cannot test actual OTP verification end-to-end since we can't read the sent email. Tested: 1) send-signup-otp returns success for new email, 2) send-signup-otp returns 400 for existing email, 3) rate limiting works (1 per 60s), 4) wrong OTP returns error with attempts remaining, 5) register without emailVerificationToken returns 400, 6) register with invalid token returns 400. Frontend UI verified: registration form shows 'Verify Email with OTP' button after email availability check, forgot password page shows mode selector.
